scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:static: npm run db:check && npm run lint && npm run format
scripts.lint: npm run lint:core && npm --prefix app run lint
scripts.lint:core: for package_dir in common/*; do if [ -f "$package_dir/tsconfig.json" ]; then eslint --max-warnings 0 "$package_dir/**/*.ts" || exit; fi; done && eslint --max-warnings 0 "server/**/*.ts" && eslint --max-warnings 0 "platform/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && eslint --max-warnings 0 "demo/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:core && npm --prefix app run lint:fix
scripts.lint:fix:core: for package_dir in common/*; do if [ -f "$package_dir/tsconfig.json" ]; then eslint --max-warnings 0 "$package_dir/**/*.ts" --fix || exit; fi; done && eslint --max-warnings 0 "server/**/*.ts" --fix && eslint --max-warnings 0 "platform/**/*.{ts,tsx}" --fix && eslint --max-warnings 0 "demo/**/*.{ts,tsx}" --fix
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:app
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format:fix

toolResultError: Why: @ag-ui/core lacks a typed TOOL_CALL_RESULT.error field and @ag-ui/client drops it, so streamed tool failures lose their failure status.
Upstream: https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui/pull/2549 adds optional string error and preserves it as ToolMessage.error.

TODO(remove): After upgrading both packages to releases with this fix, delete both patches and their registrations, regenerate bun.lock, and retain the regression tests. See patches/README.md#tool-result-failures.
activity: Why: @assistant-ui/react-ag-ui drops non-A2UI Activity messages; this patch preserves their type, content, ID and metadata as data parts.
Upstream: https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/issues/5348 and PR #5352 restore A2UI only; generic Activity-to-data conversion remains a local proposal.

TODO(remove): After upgrading to equivalent ordinary Activity preservation, delete this patch and its registration, regenerate bun.lock, and retain the regression tests. See patches/README.md#ordinary-activity-conversion.
